title: POCSAG: pages at 512 / 1200 / 2400 bit/s + an FM interferer
description: One paging transmitter (60 deg) sends a numeric (F0) and an alphanumeric (F3) page at each of 512, 1200 and 2400 bit/s; an analog FM transmitter (200 deg) talks in the gaps. POCSAG names no transmitter (the RIC is the pager being called, and networks simulcast), so there are no talkers: the check is the six decoded pages and the VFO's own DoA with the Digital squelch on - it is taken from the decoded batches only, so it stays on the pager's 60 deg and never shows the FM interferer.

expect.event: 512 bit/s RIC 0400003 F3 alpha: TEST PAGE 512 BAUD
1200 bit/s RIC 0012345 F3 alpha: 1200 BAUD ALPHA PAGE
2400 bit/s RIC 0003456 F3 alpha: 2400 BIT/S MESSAGE
